review_checks: Downloaded source remains data until the guard validates the private runtime. No acquired source or tool executes on the host.

The only new confinement profile has a 3 GiB per-process address cap, 600-second per-process CPU cap and 128 MiB file cap. The exact ProcessSpec also sets a 1200-second outer wall limit, 128 processes, 64 MiB trace and 2 GiB scratch. Existing namespace, mount, capability, private network and no-KVM checks remain. These are not aggregate memory/CPU guarantees.

All three source/compiler archives are SHA-256 checked before capture and inside before unpack. Compiler selected-file captures are tied to the frozen manifest. Fresh bison/flex, data and loader files are individually captured in the ProcessSpec.

The build runs upstream gperf checks, actual Icarus compilation and event/four-state arithmetic vectors. Malformed HDL must fail with a non-signal nonzero exit and a literal syntax diagnostic. Truncated step diagnostics cannot pass.

The exported archive uses the exact iverilog-install root. The original installation is renamed away before restore. A fresh HDL compilation and execution must pass using the restored path. The larger build closure remains explicitly required.

The output archive has a 24 MiB bound and is checked against the emitted size and SHA before host retention. Raw result and build-envelope evidence remain on failure. All captured mounts are reverified after success.
